landing.tagline: SaaS Platform for Medical Center Management
landing.heroSubtitle: The all-in-one platform for appointment management, medical records, laboratory, reports and more. Multi-tenancy with enterprise-level security.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need in a single platform
landing.featuresDesc: Modern tools designed to optimize your medical center's operations.
landing.feature1Desc: Schedule and manage appointments with automatic reminders and smart calendar.
landing.feature2Desc: Multiple clinics on a single platform with completely isolated data.
landing.feature3Desc: Digital medical records with prescriptions, complete history and laboratory.
landing.feature4Desc: Laboratory study management with results and report downloads.
landing.feature5Desc: Dashboards with real-time metrics, revenue and patient reports.
landing.feature6Desc: JWT authentication with 2FA, roles and granular permissions by module.
landing.clientsDesc: Thousands of healthcare professionals already use our platform daily.
landing.howDesc: Set up your clinic in minutes, not weeks.
landing.step1Desc: Sign up for free in 30 seconds. No credit card required. Set up your basic clinic.
landing.step2Desc: Invite doctors, lab staff and admins. Assign specialties and schedules.
landing.step3Desc: Start scheduling appointments, managing patients and monitoring everything from the dashboard.
landing.pricingDesc: Transparent pricing. No hidden costs. Cancel anytime.
landing.testimonialsDesc: Over 2,400 medical professionals already trust us.
landing.testimonial1Text: We reduced no-shows by 40% with automatic reminders. The integrated laboratory management saved us 3 hours daily.
landing.testimonial2Text: The predictive analytics panel helped us optimize schedules and increase capacity by 25%. Incredible.
landing.testimonial3Text: We migrated from a legacy system in 2 weeks. The support was exceptional. Now everything works from the phone.
landing.faq1Q: Do I need a credit card to get started?
landing.faq1A: No. The 14-day trial is completely free and requires no credit card. If you decide to stay, you choose the plan that best fits your clinic.
landing.faq2Q: Can I migrate data from another system?
landing.faq2A: Yes. We offer free data migration for Professional and Enterprise plans. Our team handles the complete process without interrupting your operations.
landing.faq3Q: Does it comply with HIPAA and health regulations?
landing.faq3A: Yes. It complies with HIPAA, ISO 27001 and all health data protection regulations. We offer end-to-end encryption and complete auditing.
landing.faq4Q: How many users can I have?
landing.faq4A: It depends on the plan. Basic allows up to 5 doctors, Professional up to 20, and Enterprise is unlimited. All plans include lab and admin users.
landing.faq5Q: Do you offer support in Spanish?
landing.faq5A: Yes. All our support is in Spanish. Professional and Enterprise plans include priority support with guaranteed response time.
landing.ctaDesc: Join hundreds of clinics that have already transformed their operations with our platform.
landing.footerDesc: The leading SaaS platform in medical management for healthcare centers in Latin America.
landing.loginVisualSub: Modern platform for comprehensive management of your medical center
